nodes.rationale: Each stage consumes the previous stage's structured JSON output; the graph UI reads the same JSON so there is no separate graph data source.

nodes.label: Dependency Graph Builder (dependency_graph)
nodes.rationale: One git cat-file --batch call and a blob-SHA parse cache keep graph building fast; type-to-type edges only.

nodes.label: Git Change Extractor (git_analysis.changes)
nodes.rationale: Uses git diff -z for NUL-separated unescaped paths; one git call per file is simple and robust but slow for huge diffs.

nodes.label: Java Declaration Mapper (java_analysis)
nodes.rationale: Reads raw bytes via git show so line numbering matches git diff; syntax errors make the whole file unresolved rather than partially guessed.

nodes.label: Known Limitations (class-level impact, no reflection/DI edges)

nodes.label: Probability Calibration (Platt / isotonic)

nodes.label: Risk-Aware Test Selector (decide / RiskPolicy)
nodes.rationale: Orders by p per estimated second, always keeps changed tests, fills time budget, then broadens until skip risk meets target; unfamiliar commits go to retest-all.

nodes.label: Selection Baselines: all / dependency / coverage (D-016)
nodes.rationale: compare_strategies evaluates each strategy against ground-truth results.json, measuring missed failures rather than assuming safety.

nodes.label: Confirmed / Heuristic / Unresolved Edge Labels (D-010)
nodes.rationale: Heuristic relationships must never be claimed as guaranteed dependencies; unresolved names are recorded with reasons instead of guessed.

nodes.label: run_git Safe Git Subprocess Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Argument lists with no shell, core.fsmonitor=false and --no-ext-diff --no-textconv stop analysed repositories from launching helper programs; revisions starting with '-' rejected.

nodes.label: Estimated Skip Risk 1 - Prod(1 - p)
nodes.rationale: Assumes independent test failures; the experiment measures rather than assumes how optimistic or pessimistic this is.

nodes.label: Syntactic Declaration IDs (D-009)
nodes.rationale: Nothing is resolved; IDs use names and parameter types as written, so import-only renames look like delete+add.

nodes.rationale: Real CI test-class outcomes for 20 Java projects already linked to Git commits, so features can be computed without building or executing third-party code (D-032).

nodes.rationale: Rows are emitted before the commit's outcomes are added to per-test history state, so no future information leaks into features.

nodes.norm_label: source history prefix before target test window
nodes.rationale: Stop at the first source commit not older than the target test period (by Git committer date) so no later history leaks into fitting.

nodes.norm_label: failure in any job counts as failure (d-021)
nodes.rationale: Builds can span several commits and jobs (per platform); one row per job is kept as source and repeated in-job runs are merged with any failure winning.

nodes.label: Dataset Storage and Provenance Rules
nodes.rationale: Raw/private data stays git-ignored; record source, version, date, licence, checksum and producing script for every dataset.

nodes.label: Chronological 60/20/20 Split with Five Seeds
nodes.rationale: No shuffling prevents future leakage; seeds change model randomness only, not the split.

nodes.label: Class-Weight Check: Unweighted Baseline (D-037)
nodes.rationale: Balanced class weights inflate raw probabilities, making uncalibrated a weak baseline; most ECE gain undoes weighting, but calibration still needed for B10 to hold its risk target.

nodes.label: Defects4J Secondary Dataset
nodes.rationale: Controlled check of whether selection catches real faults; needs Perl, SVN, Java 11 (awkward on Windows).
